notes.title: Niche News & How to recover lost save files on Mac
notes.content:
Hi Pack!

First of all, we wanted to give you a quick heads-up about all the things that are currently happening in the Niche universe :)

- We are porting Niche to Xbox1 and PS4.
- We will soon release 'Niche - Breed and Evolve' (a new Niche game for mobile that focuses mostly on breeding and less on survival)
- We are soon running a Kickstarter for Adam plushies (and they turned out super cute!)
- We are writing a draft for a book with an author about the story of Adam's sister Nara
(though this is still very WIP and we're not sure what will happen with it)
- And Philomena (Niche's lead game designer) started programming a new Niche-related prototype and is documenting it in our [url=https://strayfawnstudio.com/community/index.php?/topic/11545-tinkering-on-a-niche-prototype-thingy-once-again/]forums[/url] ^^

Come join us in the [url=https://strayfawnstudio.com/community/]forums[/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/89CQQuT]Discord[/url] if you want to chat about any of these :D

------

The second topic for today's community news is a bug we had with save files on MacOSX:
Since December 17th Niche  is using a new folder for the save files on MacOSX. Unfortunately this caused problems with the Steam Cloud sync and it did not sync the files anymore. The Cloud Sync should now be fixed and work again. You might get a popup asking if you want to download the old saves or upload the new ones when you start the game.

To recover old save files that were created before the 17th of December you have to copy them into the new save folder.

Here is how you can do that:
- Open the Finder
- Click on Go in the top bar, hold the Option Button so you can see the Library Folder
- Then click on Library
- In Library/Application Support are two Niche folders:
unity.Team Niche.Niche - a genetics survival game/Saves <- This folder is not used anymore and contains the save files before December 17th.
com.strayfawnstudio.niche/Saves <- This is the new folder which contains the saves made after December 17th.
- Copy the old save file that you want to play from unity.Team Niche.Niche - a genetics survival game/Saves to com.strayfawnstudio.niche/Saves
- If there already is an new save for the same slot, it will be overwritten. So make sure to make a backup copy of a save before overwriting it, if you want to keep it.¨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25155836/92138a387b0f62f9ee1f488464d0571b0efd6664.png[/img]

We are sorry for the problems that this change caused.
Hopefully this guide helps you to recover your old saves. If you still have trouble write us an email to support@strayfawnstudio.com and we can help you.

Cheers & Thanks
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Our new game The Wandering Village just launched on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Dear pack,

We just launched the Kickstarter campaign for our next game: [b]The Wandering Village[/b]!
The Wandering Village is a brand-new city-building simulation game where you build a settlement on the back of a giant, wandering creature. Have a look at our trailer to get a feeling what the game is about:

[previewyoutube=1VsBOgA7RZk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]About the game[/h3]
Mysterious plants are spreading all over the earth, emitting toxic spores as they grow. 
A group of people seeks shelter on the back of a giant, wandering creature. Becoming their leader, players build both their settlement and a symbiotic relationship with the gentle beast to survive together in this hostile, yet beautiful post-apocalyptic world that now surrounds them.

For more information about the game please visit the Steam page and don't forget to wishlist it <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121640/The_Wandering_Village/

[h3]Kickstarter[/h3]
Like we did with our other games Niche and Nimbatus we are launching a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/strayfawnstudio/the-wandering-village]Kickstarter campaign [/url]for The Wandering Village where you can support us and get some awesome rewards in return! The campaign will be live for the next 30 days, please make sure to check it out :)

We also set up a new [url=https://discord.gg/bJagRfx]Discord server[/url] for the game. Come and join us to share your ideas about the game, chat with us and meet other fans! 

Cheers & Thanks
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: New update - Wings & Whale Island is out!
notes.content:
Hey pack :)
The new update featuring wings and the whale island is now live.
A huge thanks to everyone who helped with the bug testing <3

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25155836/c1e91322aa8a5e725ef0bb64aad60c68936aaff9.png[/img]

[h1]Community Voting[/h1]
[The voting to decide what will be added in the next update, starts NOW!
Suggest things and vote for your favorite ideas until July 9th!
Head over here to participate:
https://strayfawnstudio.com/community/index.php?/forum/15-feature-requests/

[h1]Patch notes, version 1.1.4 [/h1]
	[b]New Features[/b]
	[list]
[*]	New paw gene (Wings) to jump over obstacles, swoop and sit on trees
[*]	New island (Whale Island)
[*]	Blue Birds can now be attacked if your animal can fly
[*]	New horn gene (Antenna) for weather prediction
[*]	New head gene (Purring Head) to heal surrounding pack mates
[*]	New head gene (Beak) which gives digging and collecting ability
[*]	New tail gene (Scorpion Tail) which makes animals venomous
[*]	New tail gene (Fin Tail) which gives high swimming ability
[*]	New tail gene (Peacock Tail) only works for males and attracts wild females
[*]	Lots of new trees! (Palms, Acacia, Mangrove, Asp)
[*]	Call when sitting on high places to attract wild Nichelings
[*]	Day Counter
	[/list]
	[b]Improvements[/b]
	[list]
[*]	Spiky body babies can't be picked up by blue birds anymore
[*]	Leeches die when they attach themselves to toxic body creatures
[*]	Armored body is impervious to leeches
[*]	Damage from cacti and thorns depends on defense (3+ defense = no damage)
[*]	Added different assets for travel ports (which show difficulty of new island)
[*]	Digging paws now give digging +2
[*]	Oak Nuts can now be smelled
[*]	Lowered default animal texture resolution for players with less than 4GB RAM
	[/list]
	[b]Bugfixes[/b]
	[list]
[*]	Arctic Ram Foxes now die of old age
[*]	Camouflage should now work with more fur color and grass combinations
[*]	Fixed several bugs when loading a savefile
[*]	The Animation when moving an animal should not loop anymore
[*]	Normal Blood Clotting can now be mutated
[*]	Identical Twins achievement should be awarded correctly
[*]	Globetrotter / Homecoming should not be awarded too early anymore
[*]	Clams / leeches no longer spawn on land
[*]	When restarting with the same bloodline, animals no longer can be blind
[*]	When restarting with the same bloodline, animals no longer can have the same immunity genes
[*]	Filtering for tail genes with spiky body now shows results
[*]	There should not be multiple digging buttons on an underwater field
[*]	Skeletons should now also appear on tree stumps
[*]	Visual fixes for poison fangs
[*]	Fixed Berry bush savannah double attack icon
[*]	Family tree can now be opened during the tutorial correctly
[*]	Survive in cold climate requirement now only requires temperature -1 instead of -2.
[*]	Toggling the UI on and off should not disable all notifications anymore
[*]	Typing 1,2 or 3 as the animal name should not toggle the senses anymore
	[/list]

We hope you enjoy all the new stuff!
If you have any trouble please reach out to us.
The best way to reach us is in our forums, which we check daily.
https://strayfawnstudio.com/community/
Or via email support@strayfawnstudio.com

Cheers & Thanks a lot,
Your Stray Fawn Team

notes.title: Patchnotes version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hi pack

Thanks for all the bug reports! We fixed a lot of stuff.
Here are the patch notes for version 1.1.1:
https://strayfawnstudio.com/community/index.php?/topic/861-patch-notes-111/

Version 1.1.1 is currently on the release_preview branch. We'd recommend only playing this version if you want to help with bug testing. If you want to enjoy the finished, bug free update, please wait for it to come live on the main branch. If you want to jump right, please switch to the preview branch on Steam. 

Switching to the preview branch:
– Open your Steam library
– Right click on Niche
– Click on properties
– Select the Beta tab
– Select the release_preview branch from the drop down
– Restart Steam if the game does not update
– Let the game update
– Open Niche and play

Please report bugs [url=https://strayfawnstudio.com/community/index.php?/forum/14-bugs/] here [/url]
and read the instructions on how to report bugs, before posting! Thanks :)

Come join our [url=https://strayfawnstudio.com/community/] forums [/url] and let us know what you think about the new update.

Cheers and Thanks,
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Patchnotes version 1.0.7
notes.content:
Hi pack

We just pushed a new build with some fixes and improvements to the main branch. Most of these things were already in place on the preview branch (version 1.0.6). A big thanks to everyone who helped with the testing <3

Improvements
- Improved tutorial, now fully localised
- Added new UI tooltips 
- Updated credits
- Attacking rogue males prevents them from mating for a short time
- Option to change animal texture resolution
(Set to low to increase performance)
- Added support for 64bit Windows and Linux
-> Because of this you will now see a pop-up when playing with older versions on other branches. If you do, please choose the second option :)


Fixes
- Disabled UI key U, when renaming animals
- Leeches can no longer move on land
- Fixed problems with camouflage


Cheers and Thanks,
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: First community voting & Nimbatus Kickstarter
notes.content:

As promised we are now opening the first round of community suggestions :D

[h1]How long will this run?[/h1]

Suggestions will be open from November 3rd - 30th.

Everybody can make suggestions on how to improve and further develop Niche.

notes.title: Update 1.0 - Leaving Early Access!
notes.content:
Dear pack

The day has come. After one year of Early Access, lots of new features, content and countless bugs xD

A HUGE THANKS to every single person who helped with Niche's testing and improved the game with their feedback and suggestions.

Niche has shaped up to be a game we are really proud of. But, we think there is a more potential that we haven't touched yet. We want to keep expanding Niche with your ideas. In order to do so, Niche has to finance its further development. Please help us to reach as many people as possible so we can keep expanding Niche! We put together a list of helpful things <3

http://niche-game.com/supportniche/

Again, thank you all so much for being with us all this time, you are the best pack we could have ever wished for!

Cheers,

notes.title: Update Preview 0.5.5 - Release preview
notes.content:
Hey pack!

Things are getting serious.
We decided on a launch date: Thursday, September 21st 2017.
That is just four weeks from now! Until then all new versions will remain on their separate branches. On launch day they will be pushed on to the main branch. Now we need all the help we can get to make sure the release version runs like a charm, so all new pack members discovering the game on launch have a great time experiencing it for the first time ^^

Please note: If you just want to play and enjoy the game DON'T play this version. This version is for bug testing and feedback. Your game will automatically update itself as soon as the update runs well and is pushed to the main branch.

Please help us test this version and report feedback here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/440650/discussions/1/1471969431578238854/
In case you speak German, French, Spanish, Chinese or Russian, please play the game in your language and report translation issues :)

The launch will be an extremly important event for Niche and our studio. We would love to keep adding more features to the game and really hope it will sell well enough to enable us to do so. All infos about Niche’s future here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/440650/discussions/1/1368380934282493056/

--------------------------------------------------

What is new? 
- Distinction between story and sandbox mode
+ selectable start islands in sandbox mode
- Tutorial (finally!)
- Steam achievements
- 5 available save slots
- Polishing and bug fixes
- Ui is completly reworked (It took me a while to get used to it xD)
- Localisation to French, Spanish, Chinese, Russian
(a huge thanks to our translators <3)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25155836/710f755afc070629dc5571a2578e36687cef7da5.png[/img]

The tutorial includes a few references to the intro video (which is currently in production and looks awesome :D) which are probably a but confusing.

--------------------------------------------------

How to get the update:
> right click on Niche in your library
> click on properties
> select the beta tab 
> select the dropdown and choose “release_preview"
> the game will update, please wait (restart Steam if the game is not updating)
> play :D
> report bugs and leave feedback here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/440650/discussions/1/1471969431578238854/

If you are a Youtuber/Streamer:
Please inform your viewers how to access the update and let them know it is a preview version.

This update features a lot of new content and we had to rebuild the game quite a bit. Because of this older save files will unfortunately not be compatible with this update. 

We are really curious to hear if the game runs well on your computers now since we hope to have fixed some of the performance issues.

Known issues (currently fixing):
- Some animal textures (mainly for right paws) are misplaced
- Blue bird fly around weirdly
- Title screen not fit for all screen resolutions

Thank you all very much for your time and support :)

Cheers, 
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.content:
Finally the update is on the preview branch :)
Pretty much the WHOLE dev team was sick during the last weeks, so please excuse the delay! As usual this version is not quite finished and still rather buggy, that's why we uploaded it on a separate branch.

Please note: If you just want to play and enjoy the game DON'T play this version. This version is for bug testing and feedback. Your game will automatically update itself as soon as the update runs well and is pushed to the main branch.

What is new?

- New gene unlocking/ mutation system

- New textures
- Small adjustments and fixes
(Sickness lasts only 2 days, healing plants cures sickness, ...)
- Lots of new bugs xD

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25155836/042eec97e2693e4a7f20f651f08dac03b548542f.jpg[/img]

--------------------------------------------------
How to get the update:
> right click on Niche in your library
> click on properties
> select the beta tab
> select the dropdown and choose “buggy_0.5_preview"
> the game will update, please wait (restart Steam if the game is not updating)
> play :D
> report bugs and leave feedback here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/440650/discussions/1/1457328927835841598/

If you are a Youtuber/Streamer:
Please inform your viewers how to access the update and let them know it is a preview version.

This update features a lot of new content and we had to rebuild the game quite a bit. Because of this older save files will unfortunately not be compatible with this update.

notes.title: Update 0.4 - Moutain Biome
notes.content:
Wow that was quite a ride! The game is getting bigger and bigger which makes it harder to test and fix everything, but thanks to your help we hope to have squished most of the bugs!

However if you find one we missed, please keep reporting here :)
http://steamcommunity.com/app/440650/discussions/1/1318835718939923242/ 

What is new? 
- 2 new islands (Snow/Grass Island, Snow Island) + some islands reworked
- New biome: Mountain (along with 2 new predators and 1 new prey type) 
- Twin birth and fertility system
- Updated sickness mechanic (sickness can now spread)
- New prehistoric genes
- Temperature system that allows more flexible weather and temperature events
- Added heat and cold resistance 
- Added filters to the family tree
- Added a community translation system + German translation
- Lots of big + small fixes and improvements

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25155836/a88959ba1f9e7f52cda6bf7c444c997223b56e47.png[/img]

This update features a lot of new content and we had to rebuild the game quite a bit. Because of this older save files will unfortunately not be compatible with this update. If you want to keep playing with your existing save files, here is how: http://niche-game.com/updates/

Please note that we plan to completly replace the current mutation system with a new one soon. That is the reason why the new genes are not in there. 
It seems the game's performance has suffered a bit with this update. We are currently investigating and hope to increase the performance again in the next weeks.

Up next: New mutation system and procedural fur patterns.

Thank you so much for your ongoing support <3

Cheers, 
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Update 0.3 - Jungle Biome
notes.content:
Dear pack, 

The February update has just left the bug testing phase and is now officially released! Thanks a lot for helping out with bug testing ^_^ 

What is new? 
- New island travelling system (Once travelled there is no way back, islands are randomly connected)
- 3 new islands (Jungle/Grass Island, Oasis Island, Jungle Island)
- New biome: Jungle (along with 3 new predators)
- Changed sickness mechanic (having two different immunity genes is more important)
- Added Albinism and Melanism
- Messaging System that lets you know what is happening 
- Option to banish creatures from your tribe
- Inviting creatures to join your tribe will cost you food
- Possibility to build nests
- New abilities (Scent Disguise, Stealth, Odor Disguise, Distasteful Appearance, Distasteful Scent) 
- Spiky Body no longer hurts pack mates (unless it's licked)
- Added new types of perception (smelling and hearing)
- Lots of big + small fixes and improvements such as an animal portrait in the UI

This update features a lot of new content and we had to rebuild the game quite a bit. Because of this older save files will unfortunately not be compatible with this update. In case you want to keep playing with your older save files, please head over to: http://niche-game.com/updates/

Please give us feedback and report bugs here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/440650/discussions/1/133257636776588165

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25155836/7e07868ca159f98c78839158b937cc74c812909b.jpg[/img]

Up next: Snow biome update in April :)

Cheers, 
Stray Fawn Studio
(we founded a company woohooo)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25155836/38266a20d5db70add16ee02d38ac8dc5c69b8a7f.png[/img]

- New island travelling system (Once travelled there is no way back, islands are randomly connected)
- 3 new islands (Jungle/Grass Island, Oasis Island, Jungle Island)
- New biome: Jungle (along with 3 new predators)
- Changed sickness mechanic (having two different immunity genes is more important)
- Added Albinism and Melanism
- Messaging System that lets you know what is happening 
- Option to banish creatures from your tribe
- Inviting creatures to join your tribe will cost you food
- Possibility to build nests
- Lots of big + small fixes and improvements such as an animal portrait in the UI
- New abilities (Scent Disguise, Stealth, Odor Disguise, Distasteful Appearance, Distasteful Scent) 
- Spiky Body no longer hurts pack mates (unless it's licked)
- Added new types of perception (smelling and hearing)

--------------------------------------------------
How to get the update:
> right click on Niche in your library
> click on properties
> select the beta tab
> enter “AccessBuggyJunglePreview” and click check code
> select the dropdown and choose JungleUpdate
> the game will update, please wait (restart Steam if the game is not updating)
> play :D

This update features a lot of new content and we had to rebuild the game quite a bit. Because of this older save files will unfortunately not be compatible with this update. 

If you are a Youtuber/Streamer:
Please inform your viewers how to access the update and let them know it is a preview version.

Now the big bug hunt and feedback round begins.
We would be very grateful if you could help us with this.
Thank you all very much for your time and support :)  

> please give us feedback and report bugs here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/440650/discussions/1/133257636776588165

Cheers, 
Team Niche

notes.title: Update 0.1 - Island Travelling and Grass Biome Extension
notes.content:
Dear pack,

The October update has finally arrived :)
There might still be some bugs around, that's why we decided to release the update on a separate Steam branch for now. You can find all the infos here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/440650/discussions/1/305510202675840196/

What is new?

- There are now three islands instead of just one. Your tribe can migrate between them.

- Adjusted difficulty level. We decided to implement a "difficulty" (mostly influences spawn rates) as well as a "complexity" (decides which objects can be on the island) level. The first island has low complexity and low difficulty, the island to the right has high complexity and medium difficulty, the island to the top has high complexity and high difficulty. 

- New field types for the grass biome

- New genes (eye colors, fur color, immunity genes)

- Option to "mark" an animal by changing its action points color. Select and animal and click on the green action points in the ui.

- Bug fixes

Cheers, 
Team Niche

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25155836/13828416dcf05a702fdc7cc510534cc1d0c4d6c9.jpg[/img]



--------------------------------------------------
How to actually get the update:
> right click on Niche in your library
> click on properties
> select the beta tab
> enter “supermutation” and click check code
> select the dropdown and choose preview
> the game will update, please wait (restart Steam if the game is not updating)
> play :D 
> please give us feedback and report bugs
